Confirmed mark preserves Coates numbers when removal is not selected

note: Both final-build runs passed 20/20 with practice edits captured inside isolated browsers. The harness allowed live-service GETs only. Screenshots were taken after the drawer slide settled, with animations disabled and the transient practice toast dismissed; measured edges are inside the viewport. Initial mapping test fixture selected a sheet without sheet_id; final runs select a named drawing. No application change was needed for either test correction.
